question: Does the fixed validation-selected lexical method improve final query-level paragraph retrieval over fixed BM25 on this declared SQuAD-derived task?

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as declared by official dataset site; attribution and original downloaded bytes retained

derivation.corpus: All paragraphs, in original article/paragraph order; doc ID squad11-<article_index>-<paragraph_index>, title from original article, context as text, metadata empty. Abort if source limits fail; do not retune or silently truncate.
derivation.queries: Original question text and ID; reject duplicate IDs. Do not inspect answer spans/content for ranking, sampling or strategy choice.
derivation.duplicate_query_text: Group by question.strip().casefold(); keep lexicographically smallest original qid, before splitting and without using scores or labels.
derivation.selection: Sort unique questions by (SHA256(UTF8('s045-squad-paragraph-v1:' + qid)), qid); take first 300; abort if fewer than 300.
derivation.qrels: One positive grade1 for the question's original paragraph ID. This is a derived paragraph-mapping task, not exhaustive relevance judgments or answer generation.
derivation.unit: query; shared corpus can contain the same paragraph across splits, no unseen-document claim
derivation.private_final: Final queries/qrels registered separately before any primary or controller request; never in development packet/context/prompt/report input. Raw source/derivation retained privately for provenance.

methods.protocol: existing staged_relevance_adapter fixed COMPARISON, no parameter search
methods.selection_rule: validation Recall@20 candidate-minus-baseline > 0 chooses TFIDF; zero or negative chooses BM25; unknown/corruption stops
methods.final: Once after freeze, compare selected method and same fixed BM25 on all 100 final queries; if selected BM25 share actual ranking/scoring, report delta0 without pretending a second method ran.

limits: Public SQuAD development data can be known; this is procedural split separation, not blinded or OS-isolated science.
Questions and answer-bearing paragraph mapping are derived from QA annotation; other relevant paragraphs may be operationally unjudged.
Results describe this fixed sampled retrieval task, not QA answer quality, sealed RSI, causal memory benefit or full original Gates.
